children: DataMeds AI entered into a Stock Purchase Agreement to acquire all outstanding shares of Helomics from Axe Compute. Consideration includes 636,328 shares of DataMeds AI common stock (about 19.99% of pre-deal shares) and a $1,363,672 convertible promissory note bearing 7% interest, convertible at $1.00 per share subject to stockholder approval and price protection provisions. The note is subordinated to certain indebtedness and will automatically convert upon stockholder approval; the company will seek approval within 75 days. Seller agreed to a 12-month lock-up on securities received and to vote its shares in line with the board for six months.
: Stock purchase agreement to acquire all shares of Helomics
: Acquire Helomics to expand diagnostics and AI capabilities
